lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hi, this is Maya from Solara Health Shield. I help people find out which health plan fits them. Is now an alright time for a few quick questions?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Great. What made you look into health cover just now?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Does the plan cover dental treatment?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text:
Dental treatment is not covered on any of our plans. The only exception is for reconstructive work needed after an accident.
And how old are you?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: What is the capital of France?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text:
I do not have that detail here. I can have someone check and come back to you. 
Are you currently living in the Philippines?
